[Description]
Description="ZAlign:\0A*****\0AThis QuickDrop PlugIn allows the fast and clean arrangement of Fornt Panel elements.\0AOn a front panel all controls are automatically arranged according to the connector pane and the window size is adjusted. \0AControls that are not connected are listed under Locals.\0A\0AThe grid used can be customized in the ZAlign.ini file in the installation directory.\0A(C:\\Program Files (x86)\\National Instruments\\LabVIEW 20XX\\resource\\dialog\\QuickDrop\\plugins\\ZAlign)\0A\0AThere is also an extended mode for GUI front panels (HowTo).\0A\0A\0AHow to Use:\0A*******\0AOn a front panel all controls are automatically arranged and the window size is adjusted. \0AKey commands to run ZAlign:\0A1) CTRL-Space (start QuickDrop)\0A2) Run CTRL-A ZAlign\0A\0AThere is also the extended mode for GUI front panels. In this case the elements must be selected which \0Ashould be aligned. The controls are then arranged in the upper left quadrant. Everything else remains\0Aunchanged at its position."
